title: Online tutoring marketplace
whyItFails: Disintermediation. Tutors and parents go direct after the first session. Seasonal demand. Exams drive spikes. High acquisition cost. Parents are expensive to acquire.
whatWouldChange: AI tutoring changing the cost structure, though it competes rather than helps.

attempts.notes: Lenders began bankruptcy proceedings in 2024; US division filed Chapter 11.
Backed by Sequoia and Y Combinator.

reasons.detail: Disintermediation: Tutors and parents go direct after the first session.
High acquisition cost: Parents are expensive to acquire.
